name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, fueled by his grandfather's stories of working on vintage rally cars. This sparked a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining. After graduating, he honed his skills at a small, local engineering firm, where he quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues.

Driven by a desire to work at the highest level of motorsport, Krzysztof joined Chip Ganassi Racing. He approaches his work with an unwavering commitment to excellence, always seeking innovative solutions to improve the performance and reliability of the team's machinery. He's particularly adept at identifying potential weaknesses in designs and suggesting modifications to enhance durability. What sets Krzysztof apart is his ability to blend traditional machining techniques with cutting-edge technologies, resulting in components that are both robust and highly precise.

physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a small, antique caliper on his desk as a good luck charm.
Insists on using only Polish-made tools whenever possible.
Frequently hums traditional Polish folk songs while working.
